summary: SIEM feed s109_single is degraded by tool overload: 4.35 Gbps bursts (435% of 1 Gbps port) in 3 intervals will cause random drops and detection gaps.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding aggregated bursts peaking at 4.35 Gbps directly to a single 1 Gbps SIEM port without load-balancing, filtering, or rate-shaping. 3 intervals exceeded 80% threshold, reaching 435% of port capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM ingress buffer overruns and drops excess packets indiscriminately; logs/events lost, correlation incomplete, alerts missed and detection coverage degraded despite SIEM not requiring full payload or bidirectional flow.

params.alternative: filter to required event sources or upgrade to 10Gbps

recommended_fix.why: Distribute ~4.35 Gbps peak across 5x1G or 1x10G so no port exceeds ~80% utilization; prevents random drops while preserving complete event stream for SIEM detection. Filtering/slicing also viable since SIEM needs_full_payload=false.
